name: skill-health
description: Checks the skills you use for instructions that no longer work, fixes them one line at a time, and updates skills that have a newer copy at their source. Tells Claude what is wrong at the start of a session, with no app needed. Mac only: needs macOS 27 or later, and jq, which ships with macOS 15 and later.

session_note.title: Session note
session_note.description: One line at the start of a session, at most once a day, when a skill you use has a failing or deprecated instruction. Turn this and Corrections for Claude both off to stop the plugin's background refresh.

corrections_for_claude.title: Corrections for Claude
corrections_for_claude.description: Claude gets up to five corrections for failing instructions at the start of every session. Turn this and Session note both off to stop the plugin's background refresh.
